items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: I was writing out all the Wayne Shorter tunes

ctx.x:
drummer.
Well, that job lasted quite a while. I kept switching drummers. I can't remember who I'd find... I finally got Donald Bailey. That was my favorite. He is my favorite drummer, Donald Bailey -- and I got him. And that was the beginning of my trio. Probably the best trio I ever had was Donald Bailey and Monty Budwig. And then I started writing out some real bass parts. I didn't write drum parts in those days. And no piano parts. So nobody could steal the library, because nobody knew what the heck the tunes…
We had a helluva trio. And all the drummers would come around: "Where in the world did you get that drummer." I'd say, "Never mind. I got him. You keep your hands off him. He's my drummer."
